state_entry.claim: statistical_state-disagreement contract, not deterministic arithmetic exactness

claim_boundary: Low-margin proposals may be user-visible provisional text but never update textual revision feedback state.
The audio frontier still advances, and a fixed-shape canonical checkpoint reconstructs the authoritative segment.
High-margin state entries are covered by a pre-outcome randomized audit and time-uniform e-process, not an iid Clopper-Pearson interval.
Zero observed violations is an empirical count, not deterministic arithmetic proof.
